name: Personalized Rearview Mirror Car Charm
description:
KEY FEATURES

 

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from Stainless Metal frame with ornate vintage filigree design, paired with a Transparent Acrylic cover to protect the printed artwork.
    - Features an Angel Wings charm pendant for an elegant memorial touch.
    - Available in 2 styles:
        +)ONE FRAME: Single photo/design frame with angel wings charm
        +)TWO FRAMES: Double photo/design frames with angel wings charm
    - Includes a Metal Ball Chain (29.97 cm ~ 11.8 in) for easy hanging on rearview mirrors.
    - 1-sided printing on the front; back features a decorative metal pattern.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - One Frame: 6.8 x 4 cm ~ 2.68 x 1.57 in
    - Two Frames: 10.5 x 4 cm ~ 4.13 x 1.57 in
    - Acrylic insert: 2.5 x 1.8 cm ~ 0.98 x 0.71 in
    - Angel Wings charm: 3 cm ~ 1.18 in
    - Metal Ball Chain length: 29.97 cm ~ 11.8 in
    📌 Note: The dimensions of the product may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Features high-quality UV printing on transparent acrylic for clear, vibrant, and detailed personalized artwork and photo prints.

 

  • Function & Usage:
    - Designed as a personalized rearview mirror car charm for memorial displays, daily remembrance, and car décor.
    - Suitable for personalization with photos, names, dates, memorial messages, and meaningful artwork.
    - The transparent acrylic cover protects the design from scratches and fading.
    - Lightweight yet durable for long-lasting use.
    - Easy to hang on any car rearview mirror with the included metal ball chain.
    - Perfect for any car — the compact size does not obstruct the driver's view.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for family members, friends, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for memorial keepsakes, remembrance gifts, Mother's Day, Father's Day, Christmas, and sympathy occasions.
    - Great for creating custom charms with photos, names, dates, and heartfelt messages to keep memories alive.
    - Ideal as a beautiful memorial piece that combines exquisite stainless metal craftsmanship with a durable angel wings charm.

  • Shipping Time: 6-9 working days average (US)

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 

  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
